serves: A public content site with one warm brand. The values are provisional.

decisions.rationale: People come to read pages, not to operate a dense tool.
Most people arrive without an account and without training.
AA is the commitment for this public site. AAA is a later choice.
The first surface is the website.
One person maintains this starter, so the list stays short.
This starter is one brand. A second brand is out of this recipe.
Reading pages need room. Compact density is for tools.
The words should sound human and direct, not cute.
The accessibility target names WCAG 2.2, so the metric should match it.
The step names should run from 50 light toward 1000 dark.
Type and space should follow the reader's font size.
A theme change must not require edits inside the components.
The ramp scheme is described in OKLCH so lightness can stay even.
Equal lightness steps are easier to explain than deltaE2000.
Eleven names match the 50 to 950 set people already expect.
Most interface color sits in the middle of the ramp.
The provisional brand is warm, so darker steps may shift warmer.
One provisional hex is enough to name the terracotta seed.
Text and its surface should use one pair: surface and on-surface.
Contrast is a review step. This dictionary does not measure it.
A system sans font is enough until a custom font is chosen.
A 1.25 ratio keeps headings clear without a huge jump.
Body text should start at the common 16 pixel browser default.
Body copy needs a 1.5 line height so lines do not collide.
A 4 pixel base is fine enough for a reading layout.
Even space steps are easier to remember in a small system.
Controls should feel soft but still look like controls.
Cards can be rounder than inputs without a long list of steps.
Light and dark are modifiers on one theme, not two products.
A team should get tokens, CSS, and components together.
Tiers, the on-color pair, and CSS variable names stay fixed after init.
The starter keeps primitive, semantic, and component tiers.
The page opens on the light set. Dark is a modifier.
